- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A study published in 2017 analyzed fossil coral reefs on the southern coast of the Korean Peninsula to reconstruct sea-level changes over the past 7,000 years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 2017 study found that sea levels were relatively stable from about 7,000 to 4,000 years ago, with a significant increase in sea level from about 4,000 to 2,000 years ago.
